1. (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising __as an active ingredient__ a compound of formula I:

[formula I structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10 and R11 are independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, hydroxyl, amino, nitro, cyano, carboxyl, alkoxycarbonyl, carbamoyl, sulfamoyl, alkylsulfonyl, arylsulfonyl, alkylsulfonylamino, arylsulfonylamino, alkylcarbonylamino, arylcarbonylamino, alkylaminocarbonyl, arylaminocarbonyl, alkylsulfinyl, arylsulfinyl, alkylthio, arylthio, alkylcarbonyl, arylcarbonyl, alkyloxycarbonylamino, aryloxycarbonylamino, alkylaminosulfonyl, arylaminosulfonyl, alkylsulfonyloxy, arylsulfonyloxy, alkylcarbonyloxy, arylcarbonyloxy, alkyloxy, aryloxy, alkylamino, arylamino, dialkylamino, diarylamino, alkylarylamino, alkylsulfonylamino, arylsulfonylamino, alkylcarbonylamino, arylcarbonylamino, alkylaminocarbonyl, arylaminocarbonyl, alkylsulfinyl, arylsulfinyl, alkylthio, arylthio, alkylcarbonyl, arylcarbonyl, alkyloxycarbonylamino, aryloxycarbonylamino, alkylaminosulfonyl, arylaminosulfonyl, alkylsulfonyloxy, arylsulfonyloxy, alkylcarbonyloxy, arylcarbonyloxy, alkyloxy, aryloxy, alkylamino, arylamino, dialkylamino, diarylamino, alkylarylamino, or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __wherein the compound is specifically selected for cosmetic skin care applications__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care __action__.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 1 or 3, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for skin care__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically__ for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, __specifically__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory component, and __specifically__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care __treatment__.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care __or__ improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

11. (Currently amended) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 as skin lightening __agent__.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __reduction__ of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for __reducing__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __specifically__ for __reducing__ dry skin, wrinkle formation __or__ pigment defects, __or__ for the reduction of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
